isabel: Quick follow-up from today's DR postmortem. Capturing compact action items so owners can update this thread. Root causes: asymmetric withdraws during failover, missed backup manifests in 2 AZs, unclear restore handoff.

drew: I'll own A-10 (routing convergence). Plan: add 8s withdraw-grace, health-check smoothing, and a deploy gating test that simulates a 25% region loss. ETA 2026-04-14, ticket OPS-6110.

omar: I'll take A-11 (backup manifest audit). Add a nightly checksum job + an on-demand quick-restore smoke to staging. ETA 2026-03-31, job=JENK-955.

leah: I'll consolidate runbook ownership and add a pre-restore checklist (confirm snapshots, KMS access, VIP rebinding steps). ETA 2026-04-04, doc=https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dr-restore

kevin: I'll schedule a short tabletop on 2026-04-07 09:00 UTC and a full warm failover for 2026-04-21 (eu-west). drill-bot: Event created -> "DR warm-failover (eu-west)" 2026-04-21 14:00 UTC

isabel: action tracker snapshot: A-10 routing owner=drew ETA=2026-04-14 OPS-6110; A-11 backups owner=omar ETA=2026-03-31 JENK-955; A-12 runbook owner=leah ETA=2026-04-04 doc link above.
